Name: GoodWe
Description:
GoodWe is a world-leading PV inverter manufacturer and smart energy solution provider, founded in 2010. The company offers a wide range of inverters, spanning from 0.7kW to 350kW, catering to various energy needs across residential, commercial and industrial, and utility sectors. With a strong and long-standing presence in the solar market, GoodWe's PV inverters have been installed in over 100 countries, achieving a cumulative installation of 100 GW as of Q1 2025.

GoodWe currently operates manufacturing facilities across four locations globally, with an annual production capacity of 35 GW for PV inverters and 5 GWh for batteries, making it one of the leading companies in the global renewable energy industry.

Committed to being a comprehensive solution provider, GoodWe offers an extensive product portfolio that includes inverters, lithium batteries, PV building materials, EV chargers, heat pumps, and smart energy management system (SEMS).

Name: BRUGG Pipes District Heating Solutions

The Pipes division operates three production sites, various sales offices and partner companies in over 25 countries.

Name: Leapton Energy Co., Ltd.
Description:
Leapton Energy is an integrated photovoltaic company focusing on Solar cells, modules, mounting and power system R&D, production and sales. Our products includes solar cells, modules, mounting system etc. BloombergNEF Tier-1 listed.

The headquarter - LEAPTON ENERGY CO.,LTD is founded in Kobe, Japan in 2012. It is not only focusing on R&D and sales of the solar power system, solar modules, mounting system and ground screw in Japan, but also focusing on the development, management and after-maintenance of the solar power station. We have built our own solar power stations all over Japan relying on our own resources. We have more than 200 cooperation agents in Japan and the marketing network has spread across Japan, from Hokkaido to Kyushu, Okinawa. In addition, Leapton has set up the logistics warehouses in Kanto, Kansai and central Japan, establishing a high- efficient logistics distribution system. With the continuous development and expansion of the business, in 2015, a branch was established in Tokyo, which is focusing on the sales of solar pv products.

In 2012, Leapton Energy establish China headquarter in Shanghai - LEAPTON ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY(SHANGHAI) CO.,LTD, which is focusing on the sales of the distributed photovoltaic power system and EPC business.

The module factory - LEAPTON SOLAR(Changshu) CO.,LTD is established in Changshu, Jiangsu in 2017, which is focusing on the production and sales of the solar modules. With the most advanced automated production line in the world, the module annual capacity now is 3GW. 

Leapton Energy is committed to providing sustainable energy solution to build harmonious and clean living environment for mankind.

Name: LiB.energy
Description:
LiB.energy is a global producer of Lithium power and energy solutions, specializing in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of high-quality Lithium-ion technologies.

Founded at Keele University, one of the world's Top 25 universities for sustainability, LiB.energy's very foundations are based in utilizing renewable energy to its fullest and moving away from fossil-fuel dependance.

We are one of the first battery companies in the world to implement the "virtual factory" concept. Our model sees our physical factory, in Manila, combining with our various sub-companies that include cell manufacturing, electrode coating, powder production, BMS, and advanced new technology. This enables LiB.energy to be totally flexible, providing our customers with a full portfolio of current technologies integrated with real-time design and implementation for the latest mega-trends.

Born out of the changing landscape within the Lithium battery industry, LiB.energy was formed to support the global progression to a 'Net-Zero' carbon future. 

With major battery companies switching their focus onto electric vehicles (EV), many Tier 1 businesses are being left without cell supply and support. They must adapt and find new secure sources of battery technology for future development. 

Global industries need access to high-quality technology, backed up with world-class expertise to ensure survival. 

LiBerate the energy world, with LiB.energy.

Name: WELTEC BIOPOWER
Description:
Since its foundation in 2001, the WELTEC Group from Vechta in Lower Saxony, Germany, has been contributing to the success of the energy transition. The specialist has developed into one of the world's leading providers for the construction of biogas and biomethane plants. The group covers the entire biogas value chain, including the design, planning and setup of energy plants, service and sustainable utilization concepts for the output flows.

The establishment of individual, technically mature solutions with custom-tailored processes is one of the strengths of WELTEC BIOPOWER. Moreover, the use of stainless-steel technologies ensures flexible substrate input, quick and inexpensive assembly and a consistently high quality standard, regardless of the location. Apart from the entire biogas value chain, the portfolio also covers agricultural trade including transport, farm services and manure utilization. For WELTEC, proximity to customers and investors is very important. These include businesses from industries such as agriculture, food, waste and wastewater.

Name: CarbonFreed
Description:
We are CarbonFreed.

Our mission is to initiate innovative projects and develop digital products that will contribute to the decrease of carbon emissions in our atmosphere to enable a better, greener future for everybody on this planet. To achieve that we strive to exhaust recent technological capabilities as well as trendsetting software applications to further increase our company ́s positive impact. 

In the long run we do not want to focus on simply one project or topic rather than constantly screen the energy transition market for new challenges we can tackle by using innovative technologies. 

Currently we concentrate on contributing to the expansion of renewable energy resources by providing electrical planning assessments and system certificates type B for medium-sized power systems (e.g. solar systems) ranging from 135 kW up to 950 kW. 
This topic is also the origin of our first mission: We are developing a software solution that automates the elaborate preparation of such documents and thus decreases the time required significantly. By doing this we strive to relieve professional engineers while simultaneously further increase the expansion of renewable energy resources.

We operate with a “hands-on mentality” and scrutinize existing structures with the goal to get something going.  As a young, small company we are able to perform free from tight structures or hierarchies which allows us to make decisions in a fast, flexible and dynamic way. 

And in order to achieve our goals and to improve sustainably, the following premise applies: All members of the team need to pull in the same direction – in a working atmosphere that is appreciative, motivating and pushes them to be the best version of themselves. 
As a team we want to ensure that you are proud of YOURSELF.

Planning & Construction: Wir bieten einen Full-Service beim Aufbau von Ladeinfrastruktur – von der Entwicklung einer Idee beziehungsweise eines Konzepts gemeinsam mit dem Kunden über die Projektierung des Standortes und die Installation der Ladeinfrastruktur bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme, Wartung und Instandhaltung. Zu den Zielgruppen gehören Stadtwerke/Kommunen, Energieversorger, Betreiber von Ladeinfrastruktur, Industriekunden sowie Tankstellen und Mineralölkonzerne.

Name: Landesverband Erneuerbare Energien Niedersachsen | Bremen e.V.
Description:
Der LEE Niedersachsen/Bremen ist der Branchenverband der  Erzeuger Erneuerbarer Energien in Niedersachsen und Bremen. Wir bündeln die Interessen und Fachkompetenz unserer Mitglieder, fördern ihre Vernetzung und vertreten sie gegenüber Politik, Verwaltung und Öffentlichkeit. 

100 % Erneuerbare Energie

Unser Ziel ist die Versorgung zu 100 Prozent aus Erneuerbaren Energien. Deshalb werben wir für den Ausbau dieser Technologien und informieren über ihre Potenziale. Wir vernetzen Produzenten und Verbraucher und moderieren Prozesse, die den Ausbau fördern. 


Information und Akzeptanz

Es gibt in Deutschland kein vergleichbar großes gesellschaftliches Projekt das über einen ähnlich langen Zeitraum mit vergleichbar großer Zustimmung von der Bevölkerung getragen wurde wie der Ausbau der Erneuerbaren Energien. Wo er auf Vorbehalte und Widerstand trifft – ob politisch oder bei der Umsetzung vor Ort – bemühen wir uns um Information, moderieren und helfen bei der Suche nach sinnvollen Lösungen. Der LEE möchte die Erneuerbaren Energien nicht gegen die Menschen voran bringen, sondern mit ihnen.

Name: Landesverband Erneuerbare Energien NRW e.V.
Description:
Wir sind die Energiewende-Macher in Nordrhein-Westfalen. Wir stehen für den landesweiten Ausbau aller Formen regenerativer Energien. Von Wind-, Solar- und Bioenergie über Wasserkraft bis hin zu Geothermie: Gemeinsam bilden wir die starke Stimme der Erneuerbaren Energien in NRW. Wir sind kleine und große Unternehmen, Vereine und Initiativen und auch engagierte Bürger: Uns alle verbindet unser konsequenter Einsatz für eine erfolgreiche Energiewende: Wir sind der LEE NRW.

Wir sind die Zukunftsenergien für NRW: Die Energiewende soll Umwelt und Klima schützen und gleichzeitig die Wirtschaft fördern. Deshalb setzen wir auf eine Energieversorgung, die bis spätestens 2050 vollständig auf Erneuerbaren Energien beruht. Denn Erneuerbare Energien senken CO2-Emissionen, stehen für regionale Wertschöpfung, schaffen Arbeitsplätze vor Ort und machen uns unabhängig von fossilen Brennstoffimporten.

Seit 2009 vertreten wir die Interessen der Erneuerbare-Energien-Branche gegenüber Politik, Medien und Gesellschaft. Mit unserer Hauptgeschäftsstelle im Herzen der Landeshauptstadt Düsseldorf sind wir immer nah am Puls der Landespolitik.

Und in den einzelnen Regionen NRWs unterstützen unsere fünf Regionalverbände die Energiewende direkt vor Ort: Für eine günstige, sichere, und nachhaltige Energiezukunft in Nordrhein-Westfalen.

Description:
minus CO2 by carbonauten: carbonauten has developed a system for industry, companies, and municipalities that immediately and effectively reduces CO2 emissions and costs.

 It includes the production of an innovative material category NET Materials (Negative Emission Technology).  The NET Materials consist of a combination of CO2-lowering biocarbons with different binders.  The biocarbons are produced worldwide at decentralized locations from local biogenic residues and problematic substances by means of a further developed pyrolytic carbonization. Name: CropEnergies AG
Description:
With sustainable, renewable products from biomass for a climate-friendly world - that is what we at CropEnergies stand for. 

Founded in 2006 in Mannheim by the Südzucker Group, we are now Europe's leading producer of renewable ethanol. With a production capacity of 1.3 million m3 of ethanol per year, our plants at locations in Germany, Belgium, Great Britain and France produce neutral alcohol as well as technical alcohol for a wide range of applications. 

Every day, people use numerous products that were produced from fossil raw materials such as crude oil, coal or natural gas. Sustainably produced ethanol is our answer to the current and future challenges, especially in the transport sector. This is because both ethanol and the numerous by-products from our highly efficient production plants can replace fossil ingredients in beverage production, cosmetics and pharmaceutical applications such as disinfectants. The fossil carbons stay in the ground and do not drive climate change. In addition, our production process produces protein food and feed to nourish humans and animals. 

In our circular economy, all raw material components are used. In this way, we are already taking responsibility today for the generations of tomorrow.

Name: Veja Mate Offshore Project GmbH
Description:

The project is located ~95 km NW from Borkum island in the German Exclusive Economic Zone, an area with strong, steady winds. This will allow our 67 Siemens SWT-6.0-154 turbines, each with a capacity of 6 MW and a rotor diameter of 154 meters, to produce enough electricity for 400.000 German homes every year.

Over the lifetime of the park, we will offset over 18 million tonnes of CO2 from being introduced into the atmosphere, making a significant contribution to the sustainability targets of Germany, and Europe.

Name: Solarkiosk Solutions GmbH
Description:
SOLARKIOSK is the last mile distribution hub and renewable energy-connectivity gateway to untapped markets at the Base-of-the-Pyramid (BoP).

SOLARKIOSK intertwines an award winning design technology with an inclusive, scalable business model to enable and empower BoP communities worldwide through the provision of renewable energy services, products and solutions, thus creating both triple bottom line impact and profitable business centers.

SOLARKIOSK designs, manufactures, implements and operates a modular, expendable kit-of-parts, solar powered business hub, which can be deployed in the most remote areas. The solution comes with all appliances to kick-start a profitable business: multiple phone charging, refrigerator cooling, satellite TV, Internet connectivity and printing/scanning/copying of documents. The business hub is operated by a local entrepreneur, who sells solar and green products, clean cooking stoves, energy services and fast-moving consumer goods to local customers.

SOLARKIOSK solution comes with remote monitoring, connectivity, smart metering, PoS, and provides space, energy and connectivity for further local businesses as well as community purposes (health, education), hence evolving into the Connected-Solar-Market-Center of the respective BoP community.

SOLARKIOSK was founded in 2011 by Andreas Spiess and GRAFT architects. The first projects were implemented in 2012 in remote areas in Ethiopia and Kenya. Since then SOLARKIOSK has implemented approx. 200 projects in 11 countries worldwide. In 2016, SOLARKIOSK has succeeded to integrate its solutions as a Connected-Solar-Clinic and Connected-Solar-School for refugees in Jordan.

SOLARKIOSK has been rewarded with several international recognitions, amongst them the New Energy Pioneer 2016 award by Bloomberg New Energy Finance.

Wir entwickeln, liefern und installieren zukunftsgerichtete und erneuerbare Produkte, um Haushalte mit umweltfreundlicher und nachhaltiger Wärme zu versorgen. Während Jahrzehnten haben wir die Entwicklung der Holzenergie an vorderster Front mitgestaltet und zählen heute zu den weltweit führenden Firmen der Branche. 

Zu unserem Produktsortiment gehören:

Domestic Systems
Effiziente Holzfeuerungen mit einer Leistung von 35 bis 260 kW und Wärmepumpen mit einer Leistung von 2 bis 140 kW für Ein- oder Mehrfamilienhäuser. Die Energieträger sind Stückholz, Pellets, Holzhackschnitzel und Restholz sowie Wärmepumpen für monovalente oder kombinierte Lösungen.

Industrial Systems
Unser leistungsstarkes Sortiment für Fernwärmenetze und industrielle Anwendungen. Industrial Systems umfassen Holzfeuerungen mit einer Leistung von 180 bis 8000 kW. Als Energieträger kann eine grosse Anzahl biogener Festbrennstoffe eingesetzt werden. Ergänzend dazu führen wir Grosswärmepumpen  mit Leistungen von 50 bis 3200 kW im Sortiment. Verfügbar sind sowohl Sole/Wasser-, Wasser/Wasser- als auch Luft/Wasser-Systeme, die monovalent sowie bivalent eingesetzt werden.


Neben weiteren Niederlassungen in der Schweiz ist die Schmid AG energy solutions mit Tochtergesellschaften in Deutschland, Österreich, Frankreich und Polen vertreten. Unterstützt werden wir durch weltweite Vertriebs- und Servicepartner, welche eine optimale und lückenlose Beratung und Dienstleistung sicherstellen.
Dies erreichen wir nicht nur mit bedürfnisgerechten Energielösungen, sondern mit einem Team, das sich aus einer Vielzahl von motivierten Führungskräften, Sachbearbeitern, Fertigungsprofis und Fachleuten zusammensetzt. Das Schmid-Team setzt Wissen und Können für die gemeinsame Sache ein und geniesst ein hohes Mass an Vertrauen, Verantwortung und Kompetenz.

Name: Tech for Net Zero
Description:
The Tech for Net Zero Alliance is a network of leading climate tech startups, scale-ups and investors in Germany and the DACH region. To accelerate the deployment of breakthrough climate technologies, the Alliance focuses on improving climate technology financing and supports market demand stimulation and an enabling regulatory environment.

Given the abundance of technical solutions, talent, and financial resources, we believe that achieving climate goals is a matter of speed, focus, and execution. We need all hands on deck to move faster and make Europe a climate tech powerhouse.

As a climate tech think tank, the Tech for Net Zero Alliance is a reliable partner for policy makers, investors and founders. In doing so, Tech for Net Zero supports the climate tech ecosystem in Germany, Europe and beyond.

The Tech for Net Zero Alliance was founded in 2021 as a joint initiative of the German Energy Agency (dena) with Breakthrough Energy and 1.5° Ventures. The goal is to address existing barriers to the creation, scaling, and growth of climate tech startups so that climate goals can be achieved. To this end, the alliance engages with policymakers, financiers, industry and academia to bring breakthrough climate technologies to market and scale via faster funding and better frameworks.

EN

As a medium-sized family business based in Münster, we can draw on 10 years of construction and operating experience of biogas projects throughout Germany. 
With the planned large-scale plant "nordfuel" in Cloppenburg and the LNG liquefaction plant in Dülmen, we are making a major contribution to the decarbonization of the transport sector.

Whether biomethane, green gases or green fertilizer products - we as revis want to make our contribution to a successful energy and transport transition.

Name: ÖkoFEN Forschungs- und EntwicklungsgesmbH
Description:
The name ÖkoFEN stands since its foundation in 1989 for ecological research and development of environmentally friendly pellet heating systems. Today the company is known worldwide as the specialist in pellet heating. The specialization in the fuel pellets is the basis for groundbreaking innovations in the field of pellet heating and storage technology from ÖkoFEN. Since the presentation of the first type-tested fully automatic pellet boiler in 1997, ÖkoFEN has become the innovator and export emperor of the pellet boiler industry.

In 1989, Herbert Ortner and his wife Elfriede founded the company ÖkoFEN with the vision of replacing fossil heating systems in its wooded homeland with environmentally friendly and comfortable wood heating systems. More than 25 years later, the company is one of the world's leading manufacturers of pellet heating systems.

Milestones in pellet heating technology
As early as 1997 Herbert Ortner made with the presentation of the first type-tested fully automatic pellet boiler quite a stir. This pioneering achievement was the beginning of a rapid business development. In the following years, the innovations in pellet heating technology also came from ÖkoFEN. Fabric tank for space-saving storage of pellets, pellet heating systems for low energy houses, the particularly challenging condensing technology and power generation with a pellet heating are just some outstanding innovations.

Export orientation as a success factor
More than 70,000 pellets heating systems have been delivered to industrial, commercial and residential customers. The export share of the company is currently more than 90 percent. The products are distributed by the headquarters in Niederkappel via regional partners to professional tradesmen in less than 17 different countries worldwide. ÖkoFEN has subsidiaries in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland.

Name: CUT POWER AG
Description:
CutPower is one of Europe's leading sustainability investors committed to reduce energy and CO2 consumption in the real estate, energy and mobility sectors. We are enabling the transition into a more sustainable world.

Die SAENA bietet unabhängige, kompetente und wertfreie Beratung. Sie konkurriert nicht mit am Markt verfügbaren Angeboten, sondern ist bestrebt Lücken zu schließen.

Initiator, Mittler und Vernetzer für die neue Energiewelt und den Klimaschutz!
Die SAENA bringt unterschiedlichste Akteure zusammen und vernetzt sie. Zusammen mit ihnen initiiert sie zukunftsfähige Lösungen und Strategien.

Name: The Charging Project

Name: QALITEC
Description:
QALITEC entwickelt Photovoltaik- und Batteriespeicherprojekte für Eigentümer, institutionelle Immobilien- und Infrastrukturgesellschaften sowie Investoren in Energieinfrastruktur.

Wir machen Dach-, Frei- und Infrastrukturflächen wirtschaftlich nutzbar – von der Standort- und Netzprüfung über Projektentwicklung, Planung, Bau und Finanzierung bis zu Betrieb, Monitoring, Vermarktung und strukturierter Energiebeschaffung für Großverbraucher.

Unser Fokus liegt auf Lösungen, die für jede Kundengruppe einen klaren Nutzen schaffen:

Für Eigentümer erschließen wir neue Ertragsquellen aus ungenutzten Flächen, wahlweise mit eigener Investition, planbaren Mieteinnahmen oder strukturierten Sale-and-Lease-Back-Modellen.

Für institutionelle Immobilien- und Infrastrukturgesellschaften entwickeln wir skalierbare PV- und BESS-Lösungen, die Portfolios energetisch aufwerten, Standortqualität stärken und Energieinfrastruktur professionell betreibbar machen.

Für Investoren strukturieren wir investierbare Infrastrukturprojekte mit technischer, wirtschaftlicher und operativer Umsetzungskompetenz; von der Projektentwicklung bis zum laufenden Asset Management.

Für Großverbraucher unterstützen wir bei der Energiebeschaffung und der Integration von PV- und Speicherlösungen, um Stromkosten planbarer zu machen und Versorgungskonzepte zukunftsfähig aufzustellen.

QALITEC bietet drei Vertragsmodelle für unterschiedliche Zielsetzungen:

• Betreibermodell – selbst investieren und direkt an den Erträgen partizipieren.
• Sale-and-Lease-Back – Liquidität schaffen und Nutzungsperspektiven erhalten.
• Flächenmodell mit Mietvertrag – Fläche bereitstellen, Einnahmen erzielen, ohne selbst zu investieren.

QALITEC – PV, Batteriespeicher und Energiebeschaffung als wirtschaftliche Infrastruktur.

Biochar is a product of the future and makes an important contribution on the way to climate neutrality and CO2 reduction. The carbonization process binds CO2 and removes it from the cycle. Name: Walch Recycling
Description:
Lars Walch GmbH & Co. KG is a certified waste management company and primary treatment facility - but above all, it is also a genuine family business. Here you can still take the terms 'reliability' and 'authenticity' at their word. Of course, a family business cannot do without tradition, and for us this means acting in an environmentally conscious way. 

The three brothers Lars, Matthias and Kevin Walch work every day to satisfy their customers and to establish lasting, reliable partnerships. These customers are found in industry, commerce, trade and craft, to whom the team at Lars Walch GmbH & Co. KG team offers the entire recycling range - from the disposal of electronic scrap, medical technology, rare earths and strategic metals to the purchase of precious metals. 

However, just as important as tradition for our family business is a modern mindset and orientation towards the future. Therefore, we attach great importance to constantly developing and improving our processes. Of course, this is not possible without technological progress and well-trained specialists, which is why we rely on this success factor. Regular training of our team is just as much a part of this as constant testing, maintenance and checks of our facilities. Through manual dismantling, we achieve recycling rates of up to 99%. This protects the environment and ensures compliance with legal requirements. 

For us, however, becoming better and better also means being better than required by law. We are not only a member of the "Umweltpakt Bayern", but also undergo voluntary certification in addition to the legal requirements. All together - expertise, technical progress and decades of experience in handling recyclable materials - not only ensures high recycling rates and protects the environment. Above all, it gives our customers security and also the certainty that they are in the right place with us.

The project hosts 15 PhD candidates at 9 European research facilities and industry partners. bringing together the latest scientific advances, establishing a unique synergy between the social sciences, information sciences, and engineering. Name: LAMBDA Gesellschaft für Klimaschutz und regenerative Energien mbH
Description:
Als Dienstleister und Technologielieferant rund um aktive und stillgelegte Deponien leisten wir einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entwicklung, Pflege und Erschließung der vom Menschen gestalteten Landschaft. Ein Schwerpunkt hierbei ist die Energiegewinnung in Form von Strom und Wärme aus erneuerbaren gasförmigen Energieträgern und die damit verbundene Einsparung von fossilen Energieträgern. Mit unseren Dienstleistungen und Produkten erbringen wir einen aktiven Beitrag zum Klimaschutz.

Dienstleistungen von Wartung und Service über Betriebsführung, Mietanlagen und Contracting bis hin zu Sickerwasserbehandlung und Deponienachsorge sind unsere Hauptgeschäftsfelder. Der Bau technischer Anlagen zur thermischen und biologischen Gasbehandlung sowie Gasförderung und Gasaufbereitung sind unser zweites Standbein. Dazu zählt auch die Behandlung von Klär- und Biogasen sowie der fachgerechte Umgang mit Sickerwasser auf Deponien.

LAMBDA legt Wert auf eine gute, motivierende und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur. Wir pflegen einen fairen, sozialverantwortlichen und kollegialen Umgang miteinander. LAMBDA fördert das Potential der Mitarbeiter und entwickelt dieses weiter; gleichzeitig kümmern wir uns in besonderem Maße um das Betriebsklima, die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter. Sowohl die Arbeitsbedingungen als auch unsere Anstrengungen im sozialen Bereich machen uns zu einem attraktiven Arbeitgeber.

Die LAMBDA Gesellschaft für Gastechnik mbH ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Abfallentsorgungs-Gesellschaft Ruhrgebiet (AGR), einer mittelständischen und kommunal geprägten Gruppe im Eigentum des Regionalverbandes Ruhr (RVR). In diesem starken Verbund sind wir seit 30 Jahren ein zuverlässiger Partner für Kommunen und industrielle Kunden. Darüber hinaus ist LAMBDA im Rahmen der Beteiligungsgesellschaft Minegas GmbH für die Planung, den Bau und den Betrieb von Grubengasanlagen tätig.

Daher bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, in einer starken Gemeinschaft mit kleinen Schritten Großes für den Klimaschutz zu erreichen. Außerdem förderten wir mit unseren Wasser&Wald-Angeboten seit 2016 regionale Waldaufforstungsprojekte in Deutschland über den gemeinnützigen Verein Bergwaldprojekt und fördern aktuell mit dem WWF Deutschland und Wohllebens Waldakademie Waldschutz. Ziel ist der langfristige Erhalt unserer heimischen Wälder, die als artenreiche Ökosysteme Basis für einen effektiven Klimaschutz sind.  

Klar ist aber auch: Energieversorgung ist Vertrauenssache. Wir legen daher Wert auf eine faire und unkomplizierte Partnerschaft. Wir sprechen eine klare Sprache und bieten Ihnen besten Service, wann immer Sie uns brauchen. Dafür wurden wir bereits mehrfach von unabhängigen Experten ausgezeichnet.

Description:
Lignovis designs and implements agroforestry projects with fast growing trees for farmers, wood consumers and investors in Europe. We have many years of experience in supplying raw materials to industrial biomass consumers and in the entire agricultural wood value chain.
Our goal is to use fast-growing tree species to create a climate-friendly raw material base for an age without fossil CO2 emissions and to maximize the many positive side effects for soil, water and biodiversity of such agricultural sytems.

In every project, we aim to achieve the best results while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides or, if possible, doing without them entirely.
By 2022, Lignovis had planted around 25 million poplars and willows on more than 4,000 hectares in Germany and eight EU countries, mostly using planting material produced in our own nurseries. In addition to manufacturing special machinery for efficient tree planting, Lignovis has also optimized special technology for weed control in agricultural wood plantations.

On our own tree nurseries Lignovis produces high-quality poplar planting material for up to 10 million trees a year. We test various breeds, management methods and technologies on our own short rotations coppice plantations and agroforestry systems. Here we also produce wood chips for heating plants and the wood-based materials industry (e.g. particle board, flooring, etc).

Lignovis works closely with universities, colleges and research institutes in order to continuously develop and optimize the special technologies and cultivation methods used. We implement these findings in demonstration fields at scale on partnering farms in order to create hands on agricultural wood projects that can be visited and discussed with practitioners on the ground.

Dabei reicht unsere Erfahrung vom Audi A8 (SOP 1993) mit einem 30W Solar-Schiebedach über den Fisker KARMA PHEV (SOP 2011) mit einem 120W Ganzdach-Solarmodul bis hin zum neuen KARMA Revero (SOP in 2016) mit einem 200W Ganzdach-Solarmodul. Als leistungsfähiger Innovator der Branche entwickeln wir nicht nur Spezial- und Ultra-Leichtbau-Solarmodule. Wir arbeiten wir an weitergehenden Möglichkeiten für Solarsysteme in allen mobilen Applikationen wie PKWs, Bussen, LKWs und Zügen und entwickeln Prototypen, wie z.B. für den Volvo SuperTruck (2016) mit 270W oder den Audi e-tron quattro Konzept mit 400W. Unsere ebenen Solardachmodule bringen bereits zahlreiche Shuttlezüge in ganz Europa mit reiner Sonnenenergie in Fahrt. 

Unsere BiPV-Module werden in Form und Größe entsprechend der architektonischen Vorgaben und Anforderungen maßgeschneidert und fügen sich harmonisch in die Gebäudehülle in Form von Fassaden-, Balkon-, Terrassen- oder solaren Carportmodulen ein. So konnten wir eines der größten Solar-Glas-Fassadenprojekte Europas realisieren. Das neue technische Rathaus in Freiburg wurde mit einer Solarfassade von 13.000m2 Fläche von uns entwickelt und ausgearbeitet.

Besonders kreativ und erfolgreich erweisen sich unsere Experten im Bereich des Sondermodulbaus. Beharrlich suchen und entwickeln wir neue Anwendungsfelder und überzeugen mit eNovativen Sonderapplikationen. So wurde nicht nur der Audi lunar quattro Moon Racer mit einem unserer beweglichen Spezialmodule ausgestattet, um den Mond per Solarantrieb zu erkunden, sondern auch der Solar-Presshai der Firma Anta-Swiss – ein solarer Müllkontainer zur Abfallentsorgung des 21. Jahrhunderts

•	Etablierung eines Netzwerkes zur nachhaltigen Unterstützung der Wasserstofftechnologie
•	Informationsvermittlung und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit

Name: Galaxy Energy GmbH
Description:
Das schwäbische familiengeführte Unternehmen entwickelt und vertreibt gemäß dem Slogan „Energy Systems for the future“ neue Produkte im Bereich Energietechnik und Bionik. Seit 2005 ist Galaxy Energy GmbH im Bereich der Erneuerbaren Energie tätig. Als Hersteller von hochwertigen und leistungsstarken Photovoltaikmodulen entwickelte die Familie Schöll außerdem bereits vor 10 Jahren das patentierte Indachsystem.

Unter Verwendung des firmeneigenen BIPV-Systems (Building-Intigrated-PhotoVoltaic) ist es gelungen, ein regendichtes Dach zu erschaffen, welches vollständig ohne zusätzliche Dachhaut und Eindeckungen wie Trapezblech, Asbest oder Ziegel auskommt. Dieses System kann nicht nur im großen Stil als Hallendach oder im Wohnungsbau verwendet werden, sondern auch als Solartankstelle für Elektroautos. 2011 wurden die PV-Module im DLG Fokus
Test als Ammoniakbeständig getestet und können somit auch bei Landwirtschaftlichen Gebäuden genutzt werden.
Das transparente und dämmbare Indachsystem aus dem Hause Galaxy Energy ist nicht nur Stromerzeuger und vollwertige Dacheindeckung in einem, sondern ermöglich auch eine Beleuchtung des Gebäudes mit Tageslicht.

In Verbindung mit einem Energiespeicher kann die gewonnene Energie eingespeichert und zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt wiederverwendet werden. Deshalb ist Galaxy Energy zertifizierter Fachpartner namhafter Batteriehersteller und bietet somit ein "Rundum-Sorglos-Paket" für Endkunden, Installateure, Planer und Architekten.

Die CEZ Group gehört mit einer Marktkapitalisierung von rund 8 Mrd. Euro zu den 10 größten Energieunternehmen Europas. Name: éolec SAS
Description:
For two decades, we have been developing renewable energy projects in France from our headquarters in Paris.

éolec covers the entire life cycle of a project, from site identification through development and permitting to construction and operation. The systematic and careful execution of each stage guarantees optimal results - for our partners, for ourselves and for the environment.

If you want to harvest the wind, you need to know where it blows. So we work hand in hand with the forces of nature. 
Identifying the right location for a project requires sense and intuition, as well as an understanding of local conditions (wind or solar potential, topography, flora and fauna, technical constraints, planning regulations, to name the most relevant). The best way to acquire this knowledge is to learn by doing, which we have been doing for 20 years. Thanks to this know-how, our team takes care of all aspects of securing land, from detailed planning and the necessary permits to the realisation of the project, in compliance with environmental and technical requirements. All this forms a solid basis for the successful implementation of wind and solar projects.

éolec is part of the deanGruppe (www.deangruppe.de). We have a common goal: the implementation and operation of innovative, forward-looking and sustainable energy projects.

Name: Store + Charge GmbH
Description:
Während Elektromobilität in den vergangenen Jahren rapide an Fahrt aufnimmt, erleben wir bei STORE + CHARGE schon seit über zehn Jahren die Energie- und Mobilitätswende.

Im Rahmen ihres Ingenieurstudiums legten die Geschäftsführer Dennis Dietz und Thorsten Rosin bereits den Grundstein für ihre Ausrichtung auf eine berufliche Laufbahn im Bereich erneuerbare Energien. Sie entwickelten in ihrer beruflichen Karriere zunächst Solartechnik und Brennstoffzellen, mit der Zielsetzung, effiziente Technologien für Haushalte zugänglich zu machen. Um die Energiewende weiter voranzutreiben, entwickelten Dennis Dietz und Thorsten Rosin in den folgenden Jahren Standortprojekte für den größten deutschen Hersteller für Windenergieanlagen.

Schließlich erfolgte die Verknüpfung erneuerbarer Energien mit der Mobilität. So beschäftigten sich unsere Mitarbeiter früh mit elektrischen Fahrzeugen – Dennis Dietz und Thorsten Rosin bereits zu einem Zeitpunkt, als Elektroautos noch den Status belächelter Bastelfahrzeuge genossen und Akkus höchstens in Rasenmähern vorzufinden waren. Mit ihrer Leidenschaft wurden sie schon früh zentraler Ansprechpartner für ihr Umfeld und begeisterten mit Tipps und Lösungen rund um Elektromobilität.
Bereits vor Jahren ersetzten unsere Mitarbeiter ihre Verbrenner durch zeitgemäße E-Fahrzeuge und sammelten in unterschiedlichsten Anwendungsfällen Erfahrungen mit der Elektromobilität. Seitdem sind wir für uns selbst und für unsere Kunden immer wieder auf der Suche nach smarten Lösungen rund um das Laden von E-Fahrzeugen, die das tägliche Leben als E-Mobilist noch unkomplizierter und angenehmer gestalten.
Über unsere Erlebnisse und Erfahrungen tauschen wir uns bei STORE + CHARGE regelmäßig mit unserem Netzwerk an Influencern aus. Unser Team ist dabei immer wieder auf wichtigen Events der E-Mobilitäts-Szene präsent, wie etwa dem E-Cannonball. Auf unser Wissen rund um Elektromobilität und Ladelösungen greifen diverse YouTuber, Blogger und Podcaster zurück.

Name: Xene Energie GmbH

Unser Herz schlägt für die Umwelt und für nachhaltige Energiequellen, die unsere Welt zu einem besseren Ort machen. Deswegen unterstützen wir Menschen dabei, Ihre Energieeffizienz zu steigern, CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig Kosten zu senken.

Dafür setzt sich unser Team jeden Tag ein.

Name: SOOMIQ GmbH
Description:
Wir sind Ihr Partner, um ungenutzte industrielle Abwärme mit PowerQube in sauberen Eigenstrom zu verwandeln.

Viele Produktionsunternehmen verlieren täglich wertvolle Energie über Abgas, Abluft oder Prozesswärme. Genau hier setzt SOOMIQ an: Das kompakte 20 kW (elektrisch) ORC-Mikrokraftwerk PowerQube macht Abwärme unter 200 °C wirtschaftlich nutzbar und wandelt sie in Strom für den eigenen Betrieb um. Besonders relevant ist die Lösung für KMU und Produktionsbetriebe aus Branchen wie Metallverarbeitung, Maschinenbau, Papier, Glas, Keramik, Chemie und Lebensmittelverarbeitung.

Daraus ergeben sich drei zentrale Leistungsbereiche:
 PowerQube ORC-System
Kompakte Technologie zur Umwandlung industrieller Abwärme in nutzbaren Eigenstrom.
 Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnung und Projektbewertung
Prüfung von Abwärmepotenzialen, möglichen Stromerträgen, Fördermöglichkeiten und wirtschaftlichem Einsatz im Betrieb.
 Pilot- und Integrationsplanung
Bewertung vor Ort, technische Einbindung und Planung der Integration in bestehende Produktionsprozesse.

Für Unternehmen ist SOOMIQ besonders interessant, weil die Lösung industrielle Abwärme nutzbar macht, die bisher über Abgas-, Abluft- oder Prozesswärmeströme verloren geht.
 Spezialisierung auf Abwärmenutzung
Fokus auf industrielle Abwärme im niedrigeren Temperaturbereich unter 200 °C.
 Kompakte Eigenstromlösung
PowerQube reduziert Energieverluste, verbessert die Energieeffizienz und macht Unternehmen unabhängiger von steigenden Energiekosten.
 Technologische Basis
SOOMIQ verbindet technische Innovation mit wissenschaftlicher Entwicklung und wirtschaftlichem Nutzen für Produktionsunternehmen.

SOOMIQ steht für eine Industrie, in der wertvolle Energie nicht länger verloren geht, sondern direkt im Betrieb in sauberen Eigenstrom verwandelt wird.
Wir verwandeln ungenutzte Abwärme mit PowerQube in sauberen Eigenstrom.

Name: HTCycle
Description:
HTCycle is the first of its kind waste management solution that transforms agricultural waste (biomass) and sewage sludge (mixed waste) into a profitable, environmentally safe process. The comprehensive holistic solution targets two key environmental issues: it addresses the growing problem of waste disposal while generating valuable, limited resources such as phosphorus and carbon through the process of hydrothermal carbonization (HTC). 

HTCycle’s vision is a clean-running world through innovation. We bring talented researchers, forward-thinking energy, management, technology experts and engineers to develop waste management solutions that are safe for the environment, cost-effective and profitable, resulting in end products with a high economic value.

Name: EWerk Gruppe
Description:
Die EWERK Energietechnik ist ein deutschlandweit tätiger Projektentwickler für wirtschaftliche Energielösungen in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, öffentliche Hand und Wohnungswirtschaft.

Wir entwickeln Photovoltaik-, Speicher-, Ladeinfrastruktur- und integrierte Energiekonzepte, die nicht als Standardprodukt gedacht sind, sondern gezielt auf die wirtschaftlichen, regulatorischen und strukturellen Anforderungen unterschiedlicher Marktsegmente zugeschnitten werden.

Statt „eine Lösung für alle“ verfolgt die EWerk Gruppe einen segmentbasierten Ansatz:
Energie wird dort wirtschaftlich optimiert, wo sie eingesetzt wird – im Unternehmen, in der Kommune oder im Immobilienbestand.

Was wir machen:
Wir entwickeln und strukturieren Energieprojekte für:

Unternehmen (Industrie & Gewerbe)
Öffentliche Hand (Kommunen & kommunale Einrichtungen)
Wohnungswirtschaft (Mehrfamilienhäuser & Quartiere)

Unsere Schwerpunkte:

Photovoltaikanlagen für Gewerbe & Immobilien
Energiespeicher zur Eigenverbrauchsoptimierung
Ladeinfrastruktur für E-Mobilität
Wärmelösungen & Systemintegration
ganzheitliche Energiekonzepte für einzelne oder mehrere Standorte

Dabei steht immer die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Mittelpunkt – von der ersten Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.

Deutschlandweite Struktur

Die EWerk Gruppe realisiert Energieprojekte in ganz Deutschland – unabhängig vom Standort unserer Kunden.

Für Unternehmen mit mehreren Standorten bedeutet das:

- ein zentraler Ansprechpartner für alle Projekte
- einheitliche Planung und wirtschaftliche Bewertung
- standardisierte Umsetzung über alle Regionen hinweg
- skalierbare Energiekonzepte für ganz Deutschland

So entstehen keine isolierten Einzelprojekte, sondern einheitliche Energiestrukturen über gesamte Unternehmensstandorte hinweg.

EWerk Gruppe – Energie neu strukturiert gedacht

Die EWerk Gruppe steht für einen neuen Ansatz im Energiemarkt:

Nicht ein Produkt für alle – sondern die richtige Energielösung für jedes Marktsegment.

Description:

Name: Envirobot
Description:
By HP cleaning with camera observation, an excellent cleaning result is guaranteed at all times and documented by video and photo in the same operation.
Working hours, water and fuel are used very efficiently, and costly post-cleaning is avoided.
The condition of the pipe can be seen through the sharp Full HD camera image, the causes of recurring blockages are uncovered and further measures can be initiated without delay without an additional camera inspection.
The maneuverability of the system enables easy turning into branched pipe systems from one access point, such as lateral launch. Even steering and working in vertical lines is easily possible thanks to the high pulling force of the nozzles.
The combined inspection and cleaning head travels in the apex of the pipe, where progress is guaranteed compared to crawlers or push cameras even when the pipes are almost filled to the apex.
With the switchable forward jetting nozzle, blockages can be removed immediately and travelling can be continued immediately.
The course of the pipe and problem areas of all lines, including those that were previously unknown or not in operation, can be precisely localized using the precise length measurement and the integrated location transmitter.
Rinsing out the pipe bed or further damage to already defective pipes is effectively avoided and the cleaning pressure is displayed and recorded in the camera image for information and documentation.
Sharp objects in the pipe such as shards, unknown obstacles or extreme contamination are detected in advance, which means that damage to the flushing hose and snagging or digging is practically impossible.
Due to the modular design, future extensions to all systems can be retrofitted by the customer.

Name: Everywh2ere Hydrogen
Description: European cities can become living lab for the demonstration of Fuel cell and hydrogen technologies, starting from their use in niche, but everyday applications such as temporary gensets that are used in construction sites, music festivals and temporary events. .Leveraging EU excellent knowledge from consortium partners in FC application for automotive and telecom backup power solutions, EVERYWH2ERE project will integrate already demonstrated robust PEMFC stacks and low weight intrinsecallty safe pressurized hydrogen technologies into easy to install, easy to transport FC based transportable gensets. 8 FC containerd “plug and play”gensets will be realized and tested through a pan-European demonstration campaign in a demonstration to market approach.The prototypes will be tested in construction sites, music festivals and urban public events all around Europe, demonstrating their flexibility and their.enlarged lifetime. Demonstration results will be capitalized towards the redaction of three replicability studies for the use of the gensets in new contexts (emergency and reconstruction sites, ships cold ironing in harbors, mining industrial sites) and for the definition of a commercial roadmap and suitable business model for the complete marketability of the gensets within 2025. A detailed logistic and environmental analysis will be performed in order to study the complete techno-economic viability of the gensets and a decision support tool will be realized to support end-users in future replicability. According to the crucial role of cities to promote through policies and dedicated regulatory framework the spreading of FC gensets, local authorities will be involved in the project since its beginning. A strong dissemination and communication campaign will be conducted particularly during "demonstration events" (more than 25 festivals involved) in order to increase public audience awareness about FCH technologies.

Name: TrashCoin
Description:
TRASHCOIN is a climate-tech startup revolutionizing waste management in Africa by turning recyclable waste into digital, traceable, and tradeable value. We leverage AI and blockchain to digitize waste collection, incentivize recycling at the grassroots, and connect informal waste systems to global circular economy and ESG markets.

Africa produces over 300 million tons of waste annually, yet recycles less than 10%. This gap is driven by fragmented systems, lack of economic incentives, and limited traceability. Meanwhile, millions, especially youth and women, work informally in the waste sector, often without fair pay, recognition, or the tools to scale their impact.

At Trashcoin, we are helping communities understand the value of segregating waste at the source, especially recyclable materials like plastics, by turning that waste into economic value.  Through our mobile app and USSD platform, users drop off plastics and other recyclables at designated hubs and receive digital tokens. These tokens can be exchanged for essentials like cash, health insurance, electricity, airtime, education support (e.g., JAMB/WAEC fees).

We connect the full ecosystem from households and informal workers to recyclers and global buyers, while layering in:
- AI for material quality and sorting
- Blockchain for transparency and traceability
- Fintech for real-time value exchange and inclusion

For recyclers and ESG buyers, we deliver cleaner, verified, export-ready materials at lower sourcing costs. Our end-to-end platform ensures compliance, auditability, and impact reporting, helping partners meet both environmental and social goals.

For the first time worldwide, Solarlite has proven direct steam generation commercially in a parabolic trough power plant.

Solar thermal facilities offer the most sustainable form of energy recovery in terms of the environment, resources and availability. The technology has the advantage that as direct solar radiation increases, so does the efficiency of the facilities. The facilities are also characterised by a high degree of flexibility. They can be combined with all other fossil and renewable energy sources and are thus base-load capable. Another plus is the option of producing electricity and process heat at the same time or independently of one another. In addition, the residual heat can be used for further industrial applications for example desalination and cooling.

Name: E.ON Energy Research Center
Description:
Market liberalization and concerns about climate change has stimulated increased use of distributed power sources such as combined heat and power and renewable energy systems. To cope with the volatility and the wide spread use of alternative power supplies and storage systems, novel concepts for the grid integration, automation and control is needed. In addition, energy efficiency and demand side management are enabling technologies to master the balance between supply and demand. Influencing the energy consumption and production habits of prosumers, requires detailed analysis to estimate the resulting effects on the future energy system. Consequently, energy research must not only concentrate on solutions of individual technical problems. It is equally important to devise comprehensive interdisciplinary approaches to and studies of complex questions. The institutes at the E.ON Energy Research Center, which belong to different RWTH faculties, work interdisciplinary in the field of electrical engineering, information and communication engineering, computer science, business and economics, mechanical engineering, as well as georesources and materials science.

The energy research center at RWTH Aachen University is the result of a public-private partnership between industry and the scientific community. As one of the largest energy companies in Europe, E.ON SE has come together with the internationally renowned RWTH Aachen University in order to realize this unique project. Main target is to research the potentials of energy savings, energy efficiency and sustainable energy supplies. 

The management of E.ON ERC, together with its 125 scientists and engineering staff, enlists considerable funds for research projects, not only from national and international public research funding programs, but also through cooperation with industrial partners and companies.

Name: Agile Wind Power AG
Description:
Local production of wind energy for commerce and industry.

Agile Wind Power is developer of the first large, economically scalable vertical-axis wind turbine for commercial power generation.

Vertical-axis wind turbines provide various advantages. Some of them are: 3x reduced audible emissions due to slow rotation speed. Higher safety for birds and bats thanks to the vertical rotor and a calm visual appearance. Good integration with the landscape. No heavy transport is needed thanks to smaller and lighter components, and no pneu cranes are needed due to a self-construction system. 

Agile Wind Power wind turbines stand out due to their pitch control, which is one of its proprietary technology. The individual 360° positioning for each rotor blade leads to higher performance and decreased load on the system structure. This results in less use of material and therefore higher profitability. Terefore the economically scaling of vertical-axis wind turbines become possible for the first time. 

The first product, A40 (nominal capacity of 1 megawatt) is perfectly positioned for decentralized power generation in which less environmental impacts are highly relevant (settlement areas). The technology can also be employed in even bigger wind turbines.

Regenerative Landwirtschaft ist potenziell einer der wirksamsten Hebel, um Treibhausgase in der Atmosphäre und in den Ozeanen zu reduzieren und so den Klimawandel zu bekämpfen. Soil Alliance - Verein für regenerative Landwirtschaft e.V. hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, einer breiten Öffentlichkeit die tiefgreifende Bedeutung der regenerativen Methoden in der Landwirtschaft zu vermitteln. Indem er Protagonisten, Trendsetter, Innovatoren und Pioniere der Regenerativen Landwirtschaft mit Meinungsführern und Multiplikatoren aus Land- und Forstwirtschaft, Medien, Politik und Kultur, Wirtschaft und Finanzen aus aller Welt zusammenbringt. Soil Alliance hat Seminare mit führenden Persönlichkeiten wie Joel Salatin und Ernst Götsch organisiert (weitere folgen) und plant zukünftige Projekte zur Steigerung der Wahrnehmung der Thematik bei Landwirten, Verbrauchern und Politikern. www.ernstgoetschworkshop.de/ | www.joelsalatinmasterclass.de/

Name: Entrepreneurs For Future
Description:
Wir sind Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer, die heute schon Klimaschutz voranbringen bzw. sich dafür einsetzen, dass die Wirtschaft mit innovativen Produkten, Technologien, Dienstleistungen und Geschäftsmodellen einen schnelleren Klimaschutz voranbringt.

Wir laden aktive Unternehmerinnen, Unternehmer, Gründerinnen, Gründer und Selbständige aus allen Branchen, die heute schon Klimaschutz mit ihren Unternehmungen voranbringen oder die davon überzeugt sind, dass schnellere und bessere Klimaschutzmaßnahmen nötig sind, ein, unsere Stellungnahme zu unterschreiben. 

Als Profis aus der Wirtschaft wissen wir um die Kraft innovativer Geschäftsmodelle und Technologien, die das Klima schützen und profitabel sind. Die konsequente und schnelle Einführung erneuerbarer Energien, einer ökologischen Landwirtschaft, einer Kreislaufwirtschaft und einer neuen Mobilität schaffen und sichern zukunftsfähige Arbeitsplätze. Klimaschützende Technologien und Geschäftsmodelle scheitern häufig an politischen Rahmenbedingungen, die Geschäftsmodelle und Technologien der Vergangenheit schützen. Die vergangenen 20 Jahre haben gezeigt, dass die technologische Entwicklung und Möglichkeiten für den Klimaschutz rasant gestiegen und die Kosten immens gesunken sind. Um die gesamte Wirtschaft zu transformieren, benötigen wir dringend andere politische Rahmenbedingungen.

Wenn wir jetzt handeln, ist eine geregelte Dekarbonisierung der Wirtschaft möglich. Nur dann schaffen wir eine enkeltaugliche Wirtschaft. Nur dann können wir die Klimakrise noch steuern und unsere natürlichen Lebensgrundlagen erhalten. Dafür streiken die Kinder und Jugendlichen von „Fridays for Future“; ihnen gebührt unsere Achtung und unsere volle Unterstützung.

Name: Hoeller Electrolyzer GmbH
Description:
Large-scale storage of regenerative energy

Hoeller Electrolyzer was founded to develop, to manufacture and to sell PEM-electrolysis-stacks which are needed by OEMs of systems that produce "green hydrogen", i.e. for storing regenerative energy in the form of hydrogen.

PEM-electrolysis-stacks are the core component of PEM-electrolysers and power-to-gas systems and they are needed by system manufacturers and integrators to build their systems. By means of these systems hydrogen and oxygen can be obtained from regenerative energy and water. Hydrogen in turn represents stored energy which can be used for various applications, e.g. as fuel for emission-free trains, busses, trucks and passenger cars. It therefore is a matter of manufacturing the core component for large-scale storage of regenerative energy which is inevitable for the energy transition to succeed.

Name: wirkaufendeinethg.de
Description:
Our sustainable greenhouse gas (GHG) trading platform is establishing itself as a focal point for e-drivers, fleets and other stakeholders. Based on a change in the law in Germany, the GHG quota enables owners of electric vehicles to certify and market the saved CO2 emissions of their electric vehicles and public charging facilities. 

The legislation assumes that a pure battery electric vehicle that does not run on fossil fuels saves CO2 per year in transport. The certification body for a vehicle's annual CO2 savings is the Federal Environment Agency. Buyers of these CO2 certificates are so-called quota-obligated companies, i.e. mineral oil companies based in Germany. Wirkaufendeinethg.de offers the service of application, certification and marketing both in the context of B2C and B2B2C (via mint future GmbH). 

With the white label solution for the GHG quota, mint future supplies over 150 companies and, derived from this, over 300 white label partners. The SaaS solution is used by insurance groups, public utilities, but also by garages and car dealership groups. The customer-oriented white-label platform for handling the GHG quota also offers users of wirkaufendeinethg.de after-sales around electromobility. In addition, the web application enables users to invest parts of the proceeds from CO2 trading in sustainable projects. 

In close cooperation with the Federal Environment Agency, the platform thus creates incentives for a rethink in the mobility sector.

IINAS uses data and modeling, but also applies qualitative analysis, especially regarding social issues, and considers the applicability and implementation of its findings and results as a core quality of success.

IINAS works critically on “green” economy issues, especially biomass, renewable energy, and energy efficiency. Sustainable land use and resource-related material flows are key areas of future research.With regard to resource efficiency and material flows, IINAS not only considers supply-side issues but also addresses the demand through sustainable consumption research.

IINAS has a focus on European and international issues of sustainability, but also carries out work on national and local levels.

Name: bluMartin GmbH (Swegon Group)
Description:
bluMartin GmbH is a company based in Weßling, Upper Bavaria, that develops, produces and sells ventilation systems with heat recovery. Founded in 2010, the company has been an independent subsidiary of the Swegon Group since 2016. The Swegon Group is the Scandinavian market leader for energy efficient ventilation and air conditioning in buildings, and has subsidiaries and distributors all over the world. bluMartin has experienced continued growth since its foundation and acquired an additional production site in Buchloe in late 2020.

The freeAir ventilation system developed by bluMartin combines the benefits of centralised and decentralised units, and is the perfect solution for new build and modernisation projects. At its core is the freeAir 100 ventilation unit, which is installed decentrally in the external wall and offers connection options for further rooms, such as the bathroom. 

The freeAir 100 ventilation unit is controlled as standard via eight sensors that capture data including CO2 levels, humidity and temperature. With the effective countercurrent heat exchanger, more than 90 percent of the heat can be recovered from the exhaust air. Thanks to its high energy efficiency, the freeAir 100 has been certified for use in passive houses and awarded the highest rating of A+ according to the EU Ecodesign Directive.

In 2016, bluMartin launched a product innovation that is still unique on the market today: the freeAir plus intelligent active transfer unit allows rooms to be connected to the mechanical ventilation unit without any ducts at all. The intermediate wall fan uses sensors to compare the air quality of adjacent rooms and keeps them supplied with fresh air as required.

In 2018, the freeAir ventilation system received the Component Award from the German Passive House Institute as an affordable ventilation solution for residential buildings. An ICONIC AWARD: Innovative Architecture from the German Design Council followed in 2019.

Name: HelioHeat GmbH
Description:
Thomas Edison once said “I’d put my money on the sun and solar energy. What a source of power! I hope we don’t have to wait until oil and coal run out before we tackle that.“

We, HelioHeat, a high-tech startup from Offenburg, Germany, are right on tackling that immense source of power from the sun! We deliver key components for power plants and enable the supply of guaranteed and flexible renewable energy, such as electricity, industrial high-temperature process heat for e.g. steel production or low-temperature process heat for e.g. pasta production.

Our key technology is a patented solar receiver for Concentrating Solar Power (CSP) plants, which utilizes small ceramic particles as the absorber medium of solar radiation. Compared to state-of-art molten salt technology, the particles can be heated up to 1000 °C enabling higher efficiencies and therefore potential cost reduction. Since the heated particles can be easily stored in insulated tanks, a 24/7 supply of either renewable electricity or industrial process heat is guaranteed.

Description:
The Gütegemeinschaft Sekundärbrennstoffe und Recyclingholz e. V. (Quality Association for Secondary Fuels and Recycled Wood) (BGS) was founded in 1999 with the aim of promoting the production and use of quality-assured solid recovered fuels in order to conserve natural resources and reduce CO2 emissions. About 60 manufacturers, users, as other companies and institutions are working together in the association to achieve this. 
A commitment to quality assurance is a prerequisite for the further development of the solid recovered fuel market. High availability and binding quality regulations pave the way for trade facilitation and the recognition of secondary fuels as standard fuels. 
The focus of our work is on the awarding of the quality label, the technical support of the recognition and monitoring procedure as well as all current issues relating to the processing of solid recovered fuels.
We are constantly exchanging information and experience within the bodies of the association as well as at national and international conferences and trade fairs. The support and implementation of relevant projects and research projects is just as much a part of our tasks as the monitoring of legislative procedures and cooperation in national and international committees. 
The path that brings everyone forward: 
- Targeted fuel production and a closed system for quality assurance
- Labelling of high-quality solid recovered fuels by awarding the quality mark
- Qualification of laboratories through annual performance of a round robin test
- International standardisation of solid recovered fuels
In this way, the environmentally friendly and resource-saving use of secondary fuels can be further expanded and open up new perspectives for both the economy and the environment...
...to make targeted use of these opportunities is our task, on which we are consistently working.

Diese  wurde 2018 in Annaberg-Buchholz an der tschechischen Grenze mit einer zusätzlichen Niederlassung erweitert. 
Im Jahr 2020 wurde die Reparatur-Werkstatt in eine separate Gesellschaft mit dem Namen Hilker Repair GmbH abgespaltet. 
Mittlerweile sind über 100 Mitarbeiter bei der Unternehmensgruppe Hilker beschäftigt um ihren Kunden bei jeglicher Hilfe rund um die Photovoltaik beiseitezustehen!
Die heutigen Geschäftsführer Andre Hilker, Dennis Logemann und Steffen Lohmeier gehören zu den Gründern und führen das Unternehmen gemeinsam seit 2010.

Dabei stellen wir auch interne Prozesse in Frage und scheuen uns nicht vor der Etablierung neuer Wege zum Ziel.

Durch die aktive Teilnahme an bundesgeförderten Forschungsprojekten als Konsortialführer stellen wir sicher, dass unsere angewandten Konzepte und Methoden dem Puls der Zeit entsprechen.

Wir kennen die Förderkulisse im Kontext nachhaltiger Mobilität gut. Sprechen Sie uns daher gerne an, wenn Sie auf der Suche nach entsprechenden Bundes- oder Landesprogrammen sind.

Name: Gravity Storage Inc.
Description:
Gravity Storage is a new concept with which unprecedentedly large quantities of power between 1 and 10 GWh can charged and discharged daily.

Gravity Storage connects the grid balancing imperative derived from the widespread deployment of renewables with the demand for reliable power supply.

The fundamental principle is based on the hydraulic lifting of a large rock mass. Using electrical pumps, as already used today in pumped storage power plants, water is pumped beneath a movable rock piston, thereby lifting the rock mass. 
During times of insufficient generation of renewable power, the water which is under high pressure from the rock mass, is routed to a turbine, as in conventional hydroelectric plants, and generates electricity using a generator.

The rock piston should have a diameter of at least 100 meters in order to be competitive with pumped storage power plants. We calculate with capex between 160 and 380 USD/kWh (corresponding a size of 10 GWh and 1 GWh) and Levelized Costs of Storage between 9 and 18 ¢/kWh.

Name: Circuteria
Description:
Our vision is to facilitate a society that is regenerative by design, using natural materials at their highest value to enable a truly circular economy. To this end, we are developing a digital platform that connects all stakeholders of a circular economy to reuse, recycle and compost products made from renewable biomass.

Over the last century, we have been polluting our planet and health with more and more plastics. This is because most plastics are made from fossils (oil and gas), and thus do not degrade as well as biomass. Technically, up to 90 % of fossil-based plastics could be replaced with plant-based alternatives, reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions (towards the 1.5°C goal), and protect our natural soils and waters. As of today, however, only 1% of all plastics are made from biomass worldwide. One major reason for this discrepancy is the cheap price of oil, which obviously does not include the price of harming our planet. Another major reason is a lack of understanding for biopolymer products that is necessary to accelerate their economies of scale. To promote this understanding and match the right buyer with the right seller of biopolymers, we develop Circuteria, a smart and sustainable online platform that efficiently connects and advises all stakeholders along a circular bioeconomy to produce, use, and recycle sustainable materials and products.

Our Motivation:
Due to the technologies in use today, (organic) raw materials are usually only grown, mined or used for production in concentrated deposits, although they are available almost everywhere in a correspondingly lower concentration. Further transport and today's type of growing, mining or producing are becoming more and more expensive and are increasingly problematic for the environment. After being used once, most of the materials find their way into water bodies in various ways in lower concentrations, where in some cases they can also become poisons and have to be extracted using binding chemicals, called precipitants that also need to be produced and disposed. The aim should therefore be to reuse (raw) materials in the cycle several times at a local point and to avoid costly mining, transport and precipitants if possible.

Our Technology:
We achieve this goal through an innovative, cost-effective and efficient system technology invented and developed by us with a very wide range of uses for the targeted extraction of resources from water, such as polluted municipal and industrial wastewater. We have already proven our system technology in the first successfully implemented applications.

Our modular system technology enables the recovery of even weakly concentrated raw materials from fluids such as water, whereby these are further clarified at the same time.

Name: Marmony Solutions GmbH
Description:
CLIMATE CHANGE, QUALITÄT & INNOVATION

Marmony ist der Premium-Hersteller von elektrisch betriebenen Naturstein-Infrarotheizungen – Manufactured in Germany. Mit unseren Infrarotheizungen aus Naturstein leisten wir einen relevanten Teil zur Energiewende. Unser Ziel ist es, den fossilen Energieverbrauch zur Beheizung von Immobilien auf ein Minimum zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig unseren Kunden größtmöglichen Wohnkomfort (warme Böden und Decken) mit einem hohen Designanspruch zu bieten. Marmony bietet höchste Qualität zu planbaren Betriebskosten.

Wir sind auf dem richtigen Weg! 2021 wurde Marmony, im Rahmen eines Verbrauchertest von „TESTBILD“, zur „Top Marke Haus & Wohnen 2021“ gewählt. In den Kategorien „Langlebigkeit“, „Design“ und „Umwelt & Nachhaltigkeit“ ging Marmony bei dieser Befragung von über 5.000 Konsumenten jeweils als Testsieger hervor. Auf unsere Qualität ist Verlass. Unsere Natursteinheizkörper werden ausschließlich am Firmensitz in Straubing produziert und montiert.

FUNKTIONALITÄT

Die Marmony Infrarotheizungen zeichnen sich durch einen sehr hohen Strahlungswirkungsgrad nicht nur gegenüber klassischen Heizungssystemen, sondern auch gegenüber anderen Infrarotheizungen aus. Weitere Vorteile sind der minimale Platzbedarf und die Möglichkeit der Selbstmontage mit sofortigem Einsatz - ohne vorherige aufwendige Dimensionierung und Erstellung einer Heizungs-Peripherie. Vor allem in Immobilien mit einer eigenen PV-Anlage sind unsere Infrarotheizungen eine der sichersten, wirtschaftlichsten und umweltverträglichsten Heizungssysteme.

Wärmen kann so einfach sein. Wir haben eine technische Besonderheit, die zugleich auch der USP von Marmony ist: Wir können aufgrund der hohen Leitungsfähigkeit bei gleichzeitiger dünnwandiger Stärke des Steins quasi „Wärme als Paket ready to use“ direkt an Endkunden versenden und darüber hinaus dient der Naturstein als Wärmespeicher wie es keine andere Heizung leisten kann.

Name: SolarEdge Technologies
Description:
SolarEdge is a global leader in smart energy technology. By leveraging world-class engineering capabilities and with a relentless focus on innovation, SolarEdge creates smart energy solutions that power our lives and drive future progress.
Established in 2006, SolarEdge developed the DC optimized inverter solution that changed the way power is harvested and managed in photovoltaic (PV) systems. Name: Nordex Energy Brasil
Description:

Estamos presente no mercado brasileiro desde 2013, com sede na capital comercial, São Paulo. O Grupo Nordex monta as naceles e produz torres de concreto para suas turbinas localmente em suas próprias fábricas. A empresa também utiliza pás de rotor fabricadas localmente no Brasil. Isso permite atender às necessidades locais de geração de valor, o que, por sua vez, oferece melhores opções de financiamento aos clientes.

A fabricação de parques eólicos no segmento onshore é nossa principal competência e paixão há mais de 35 anos. Com mais de 28 GW de capacidade instalada em todo o mundo, nossas turbinas fornecem energia sustentável a mais de 80% do mercado global de energia e somos uma das maiores empresas do setor eólico. 

Estamos presentes em mais de 25 mercados e temos instalações de produção na Alemanha, Espanha, Brasil, EUA, México e Índia oferecem aos nossos mais de 6.500 funcionários a oportunidade de cooperação internacional e intercultural. Se você é apaixonado por energias renováveis, adora trabalhar em equipe e compartilha nossos valores de integridade, companheirismo, respeito e empreendimento. Gostaríamos que você fizesse parte!

Acompanhe a divulgação de nossas vagas no site da empresa.

Não fazemos distinção de gênero, idade, cultura, etnia, origem social, deficiência, crença política ou religiosa, orientação sexual, idade e/ou outros atributos. Queremos garantir que todos se sintam valorizados e vistos!

Name: Dii Desert Energy
Description:
Dii Desert Energy was launched in 2009 as an industry initiative in Germany, initially called ‘Desertec Industrial Initiative’ for exploring the potential of renewables in the desert areas of Northern Africa and the Middle East, improving market conditions and examining the synergies to be captured through connecting the European and MENA power markets.

In 14 years’ time, Dii Desert Energy has grown from a rudimentary ‘Desertec Vision’, initially mainly concentrated on power from the deserts for Europe, (Desertec 1.0) via a focus on the conditions of renewables in the local clean energy markets (Desertec 2.0) toward a highly recognized market enabler for ‘green electrons’ and ‘green molecules’ from the deserts of MENA for MENA’s own population, and for MENA to become a ‘Power House’ for the world markets (Desertec 3.0). Today, Dii Desert Energy is looking at the entire energy system, starting with various ways to produce Renewable Energy (RE), transmission grids, transport ways, new technologies & innovations, energy storage, e-mobility, smart cities, towards the long-term objective of ‘energy without emissions’.

By connecting the international industry active in the MENA region with authorities and institutions, Dii Desert Energy focuses on practical conditions for ‘green electrons’ and ‘green molecules’ along the energy value chains leading to tangible and profitable projects and other benefits for local and international stakeholders.

Name: eFuelsNow e.V.
Description:
Wir sind ein Verein von Ingenieuren und Fortschrittsbegeisterten, sowie Technik interessierten Freunden und Bekannten aus dem Umfeld. Unsere Initiative wurde 2019 durch eine Petition des Stuttgarter Maschinenbau-Ingenieurs Benedikt Zimmermann ins Leben gerufen, die uns alle zusammenbrachte. Da wir uns schon seit Jahren, manche von uns schon ihr ganzes Berufsleben, mit alternativen Kraftstoffen beschäftigen und wissen, wie komplex das Thema ist, sahen wir uns verpflichtet in diesem Punkt aufzuklären und als Ansprechpartner zur Verfügung zu stehen.

Unsere Ziele richten sich an folgenden Grundsätzen aus: 
1. Einhaltung des vereinbarten CO2e Budgets des Pariser Klimaabkommens
2. Schnelle und wirksame Reduzierung von klimaschädlichen Treibhausgasemissionen 
3. Nachhaltige Nutzung vorhandener Ressourcen und Wirtschaftsgüter 
4. Technologieoffenheit und freie Marktwirtschaft 
5. Gesellschaftliche Bedürfnisse, mit ökonomischen und ökologischen Zielen verknüpfen

Unsere Ziele sind: 
•	Die möglichst schnelle Freigabe und Einführung von regenerativen Kraftstoffen, als Ergänzung zur Elektromobilität
•	Faktenbasierte Information auf Basis anerkannter, wissenschaftlicher oder journalistischer Quellen. Allgemeinverständliche Aufarbeitung der Kernbotschaften, um diese einem breiten Publikum zugänglich zu machen.
•	Plattform bieten zum Wissensaustausch und Netzwerken, rund um das Thema alternative Kraft-&Brennstoffe und der Defossilisierung des Verkehrs- und Wärmesektors.
•	Korrektur von falschen oder lückenhaften Aussagen in sozialen Netzwerken, in Medien oder auch in der Politik.

Dieser Artikel beschreibt etwas detaillierter unsere Motivation und Hintergründe: https://efuel-today.com/e-fuels-now-fuer-synthetische-kraftstoffe/

Name: HH2E
Description:
We have known about the negative impact of carbon emissions for years. Now we also understand what security of energy supply and energy sovereignty means.  

Here at HH2E, we deliver good news: 100% renewable energy made in Germany is possible, including both electrons and molecules.

HH2E is a fast-growing, innovative green energy company that has developed the next-gen plant, the HH2E-Werk is capable of converting just a few hours of surplus solar and wind power per day into a steady supply of heat and hydrogen. This enables the large-scale production of green hydrogen in Germany, close to customers in optimal locations, in a cost-competitive manner. The energy transition necessitates a solution for industries requiring energy on a 24/7 basis, and HH2E provides that solution.

Innovation
HH2E's new plants have three main components: a heat storage unit, a power generation unit, and an electrolysis unit that combines a high-capacity battery with an electrolyzer. This technology-mix enables hydrogen production using only renewable power when electricity is cheaper, without a permanent power input.

The HH2E-Werk generates heat as a byproduct of the electrolysis process, which can be used to replace gas or diesel boilers in nearby district heating systems. This feature contributes to the cost-effective decarbonization of building heating without requiring additional investment by building owners.

HH2E's plan to deliver 4 GW of green hydrogen production capacity in Germany is already in motion, with the first plant scheduled for construction in Lubmin in 2023. Our project pipeline, reaching €6 billion, has already received the commitment of two serious energy transition and infrastructure funds to construct the first units. This pipeline positions HH2E to be one of Europe's largest green hydrogen producers by 2030.

With HH2E, industries and communities will have the opportunity to produce, use, share and profit from green energy in a completely new way.

Name: Adwen Offshore
Description:
Adwen is a leading player in the offshore wind industry, with more than 600 MW installed at sea and close to 2 GW in the pipeline. The firm was created in 2015 with the ambition of developing innovative and reliable solutions aimed at lowering the Levelized Cost of Energy (LCoE) of offshore wind.

The firm’s professionals count with more than 20 years of wind experience designing, manufacturing, installing and operating wind turbines both onshore and offshore. In 2009 it installed Germany’s first offshore wind farm, alpha ventus, and in the summer of 2016 it started the installation of one of the most powerful wind turbines ever built, the AD 8-180.

Comprehensive offer to bring down the LCoE
Adwen has a comprehensive offer of products and services that are key to lower the LCoE. The 5 MW platform powers three offshore wind farms in Germany and is being installed in a fourth one, which will bring the total installed capacity of this platform to close to 1 GW. 

Based in the proven technology of its 5 MW platform, Adwen has developed the most powerful turbine in the world, the AD 8-180. With nominal capacity of 8 MW and an unmatched rotor diameter of 180 meters, this turbine has the largest annual energy production (AEP) in the industry and as such it is a breakthrough development for the industry on its quest to reduce the cost of offshore wind energy. 

Adwen’s offer is completed with best-in-class operation and maintenance solutions aimed at avoiding expensive offshore reparation works, increasing availability and maximizing energy production thus leading to improved profitability for project owners. 

The trust of our customers
The AD 8-180 next generation turbine has already been selected to equip three offshore wind farms in France for a total of close to 1.5 GW for customers including Iberdrola, Engie, EDPR and RES. In addition, the new platform is widely recognized as a key addition to the industry.

Name: GREENBOATS
Description:
GREENBOATS is about developing innovative products. Products that create value for our customers because we can satisfy their demand not only in terms of costs and performance but also in terms of sustainability. 

Think of it as a space defined by three axes 1. costs, 2. performance, and 3. sustainability. With everything we are doing, we are trying to reach combinations of these three variables that have never been reached before.

We are doing this by creating an infrastructure centered around the creativity of highly skilled craftsmen that are able to act out of intuition and are supported by excellence in Engineering, R&D, and an environment that encourages unconventional thinking.

Our Vision of the future

All of this is based on a clear vision of the future. We are convinced that sustainability will be perfectly priced into products and services. When exactly that will be the case will largely depend on bottom-up pressure from the public in terms of their consumption behavior, as well as the top-down pressure in the form of new government regulation. In the end, it will come down to technology that enables to measure and communicate sustainability 100% objectively and at close to zero costs.

Since we don’t know when this will be the case, we refer to this as Horizon 3. Currently, we are in the transition from Horizon 1 to Horizon 2. Horizon 1 describes the time from 2009 when Friedrich first started exploring alternative materials until our recent and ongoing investments into our team as well as into additional manufacturing capacities that will allow us to produce at more competitive prices and deliver to a quickly growing number of clients and customers in Horizon 2.
